title: Source application accepts noncanonical top-level proof paths and emits an unverifiable complete receipt
cause: Top-level plan_path and acceptance_path are made absolute, but their repository-relative spellings are stored without the relative() canonical-path check. The completed verifier later applies that check to the saved acceptance path. CLI passes Path arguments through without normalizing or rejecting them.
reproduction: Private actual source prepare receives root/intake/../plan.json and root/intake/../acceptance.json, both pointing to existing in-root regular files. prepare accepts; apply changes owners and returns complete. verify_completed then rejects Noncanonical relative path for its own saved acceptance reference.
required_fix: Before any rendering/reservation/owner mutation, require canonical confined top-level root/plan/acceptance/receipt spellings consistently with the verifier; do not resolve symlinks away. Add noncanonical argument refusals and canonical positive roundtrip.
limits: No filesystem alias or outside-root target was used. This is proof roundtrip failure, not an identity error or claim that content was silently published.
